steps.title: Welcome to Palette Room
steps.body: Let's design this room together, one piece at a time. A glowing arrow will point at what to use next. You can go back or skip the tour at any time.

steps.title: Point and pinch
steps.body: Hold up a hand, palm facing away, and a ray comes out of it. Point the ray at a button and pinch your thumb and index finger together to press it. With controllers, point and pull the trigger.

steps.title: Your Palettes panel
steps.body: Everything starts from this panel. Panels stay where you put them in your room, and each one has a bar underneath, like a window's title bar.
steps.tryIt: Pinch the bar under the Palettes panel, move it somewhere comfortable, and let go.

steps.title: Open the shopping list
steps.body: The shopping list has every piece of furniture, in real-world sizes. Let's furnish the room one piece at a time.

steps.title: Start with a sofa
steps.body: Big pieces come first. The sofa takes the room's main color. Each + places a piece in front of you.

steps.title: Ground it with a rug
steps.body: A rug ties the seating together and carries the main color across the floor.

steps.title: Add a coffee table
steps.body: Supporting pieces like tables and shelves take the second color, about a third of the room.

steps.title: Turn on some music
steps.body: Small accents bring the last touch of color. This radio plays the music: wherever you put it, that's where the sound comes from.

steps.title: Close the list
steps.body: That's a good start. You can come back for more pieces any time.

steps.title: Move the sofa
steps.body: Every piece can be picked up and put somewhere new. Point at it and pinch from a distance, or grab it up close. Pieces glow red where they won't fit.
steps.tryIt: Pinch the sofa, drag it to a new spot, and let go.

steps.title: Color one piece
steps.body: A quick pinch and release on a piece, without moving it, opens its colors. Choose which palette color each part uses, like the cushions or the legs.

steps.title: Try a palette
steps.body: Each card is a five-color palette. The room follows the 60-30-10 rule: about 60% main color, 30% supporting color and 10% accent.
steps.tryIt: Pinch a palette card and watch the color sweep across the room.
steps.say: Try a palette. Each card is a five color palette. The room follows the sixty thirty ten rule: about sixty percent main color, thirty percent supporting color, and ten percent accent. Pinch a palette card, and watch the color sweep across the room.

steps.title: Make your own palette
steps.body: The color wheel turns a color you love into a full palette, using color harmonies. Find it here whenever you're ready.

steps.title: Design briefs
steps.body: Want a challenge? Design briefs give you a goal to design to. Meet a brief to earn up to three stars.

steps.title: Your lookbook
steps.body: Save snapshots of your rooms in the lookbook, lay a saved room out again, or send its shopping list to your phone.

steps.title: Settings
steps.body: Music, sound effect and voice volumes, the language, the main menu and Quit are all in Settings. Lost this panel? Press the menu button on a controller to bring it back.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.body: Your room is saved on the headset, so you can carry on next time. Take the tour again from Tutorial in the Palettes panel. Have fun!
